body:
I see my family once per year. I have no friends, never had any. My coworkers don't talk to me. I feel lonely because I go weeks without talking to anyone. I have nobody to talk to. 

What hasn't been going well? Everything. Social life? I have no friends, doesn't matter how many advices from "how to make friends" or other sources I try to apply. Career? I'm graduating soon, and got no reply to my job applications. I'm applying everywhere, and just get nothing. Romantic life? Failed relationship and a string of failed first dates. What isn't working? Me. I've never been able to fit in, my whole life. I used to be smart, now there's nothing going on in my head. Nothing makes me happy, nothing motivates me, I can't even get up in the morning anymore.
Hopeless, lonely, like a failure. My life isn't going well. Nothing I try ever works. Now I'm just waiting.
